problem_fixed.root_cause: findCreateButton(root) scanned every <button> on the page, so an enabled page-level control whose exact text was 'add_2 Create' was selected and clicked. It opened the Meo Story media panel; the prompt was never submitted and 0 videos were produced.
problem_fixed.second_cause: The Bridge served a stale extension runtime while answering normally, so a fixed content script was not necessarily the one running.

contract_now_enforced.submit_scope: The nearest <form> of the ONE visible composer. No unique composer, no owning form, or more than one exact-label Create inside it => no candidate, zero clicks.
contract_now_enforced.quota_scope: An enabled 'Upgrade' inside the same form, only when there are 0 or 1 Create candidates. Two or more candidates is ambiguity, not exhaustion.
contract_now_enforced.runtime_preflight: run.trial calls the read-only diagnostics.dom_probe FIRST and refuses with VALIDATION_FAILED / RUNTIME_CONTRACT_MISMATCH before writing trial history, mutating run state, or launching the runner.
contract_now_enforced.mode_reassertion: Video mode is proven again immediately before the one guarded Create click.
contract_now_enforced.probe_evidence: diagnostics.dom_probe now returns runtime_contract, composer_scope_resolved, and per-button chain + in_composer_form.

known_limit_stated_honestly: The preflight runs INSIDE the side panel, so it catches a stale CONTENT SCRIPT (tab not reloaded) only. A stale EXTENSION ships a stale panel that has no check to run. No code in the new build can gate an old build. Mitigation is operational and is now mandatory in AI-OPERATOR-GUIDE.md: read runtime_contract from dom_probe before the first write of a session, treat a MISSING field as an old build, and keep exactly one Flow tab with no tab switching between preflight and run.

tests.node_check: clean on provider-adapter.js, content.js, sidepanel.js and every edited .mjs

accepted_and_fixed: two exact Create controls plus an Upgrade was misdiagnosed as a credit wall
rejected_with_reasoning: the stale-extension bypass is unfixable from inside a stale build; mitigated operationally
the page-wide quota text fallback is a deliberate pre-existing protection and deleting it would remove a hard stop
the exact Image-mode summary label is fail-closed by design; widening it without DOM evidence is forbidden (logged as backlog F-11)

accepted_and_fixed: the composer was captured before ensureFlowVideoMode, so an Image->Video remount could leave it detached and submit an EMPTY prompt for 15 credits
blocker checks sat below the mode verdict, so a CAPTCHA on a page with an unrecognised mode summary surfaced as WRONG_GENERATION_MODE, which classifies as OTHER, which canRetry treats as RETRYABLE
waitForSendButtonReady fed a security blocker into sendReady but never threw it, so a late CAPTCHA timed out as the generic retryable message; it now throws HARD_STOP symmetrically with LIMIT_STOP
the composer was still resolved before stageReferences; it is now resolved after every DOM-mutating step and immediately before typing
rounds.note: While pinning the late-CAPTCHA case, the fixture was measured to be caught by the typing-path guard instead of the readiness loop. The behavioural test was relabelled to claim only the outcome it proves, and a separate static pin covers the readiness loop guard; deleting that guard turns it red.

accepted_and_fixed: Video mode was proven once, before staging and typing; it is now re-asserted at the submit boundary
rejected_with_reasoning: the claim that ensureFlowVideoMode's waitUntil calls do not poll blockers is factually wrong: the waitUntil helper throws HARD_STOP and LIMIT_STOP on every iteration
binding the preflight to a tab id is the stale-runtime problem restated at tab granularity, and has the same unfixable core; the operator guide now requires exactly one Flow tab and no tab switching

safety_laws_unchanged: exactly one guarded Create click per attempt
exactly one new video id is attributable; two or more is OUTPUT_AMBIGUOUS and neither is claimed
quota and CAPTCHA are hard stops
trial cap is 3 jobs and requires Dev Mode
